items.text: Nagpur sits at the Zero Mile Center of India - the country's literal geographic middle - and Maharashtra's own government treats it as a second capital, moving the state legislature here every winter.

That centrality is now turning into a real economy through MIHAN's cargo, aviation, and IT-SEZ growth, and Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology feeding a talent pool that has historically had to leave for Pune, Mumbai, or Hyderabad to put itself to full use.
Good counselling here is not about deciding for or against Nagpur in the abstract.
